description: GTEx median expression of LONRF1/2/3, resolving gencode versions by trial
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
base='https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression'
def try_gene(ens, vers=range(10,22)):
    for v in vers:
        gid=f'{ens}.{v}'
        r=requests.get(base,params={'gencodeId':gid,'format':'json','itemsPerPage':2000},timeout=90)
        if r.ok:
            d=pd.DataFrame(r.json().get('data',[]))
            if len(d): return gid,d
    return None,pd.DataFrame()
frames=[]
for sym,ens in [('LONRF3','ENSG00000175556'),('LONRF2','ENSG00000170500'),('LONRF1','ENSG00000154359')]:
    gid,d=try_gene(ens)
    print(sym,gid,len(d))
    if len(d): d['sym']=sym; frames.append(d)
d=pd.concat(frames)
piv=d.pivot_table(index='tissueSiteDetailId',columns='sym',values='median').sort_values('LONRF3',ascending=False)
print('\nTop 20 tissues by LONRF3 median TPM:'); print(piv.head(20).round(2).to_string())
print('\nranges  LONRF3 %.2f-%.2f | LONRF2 %.2f-%.2f | LONRF1 %.1f-%.1f  (n=%d tissues)'%(
 piv.LONRF3.min(),piv.LONRF3.max(),piv.LONRF2.min(),piv.LONRF2.max(),piv.LONRF1.min(),piv.LONRF1.max(),len(piv)))
piv.to_csv('gtex_lonrf.csv')
top=piv.head(16)[::-1]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.8,6.4)); y=np.arange(len(top)); h=0.26
for k,(c,col) in enumerate(zip(['LONRF3','LONRF2','LONRF1'],['#1f77b4','#2ca02c','#d62728'])):
    ax.barh(y+(k-1)*h, top[c].values, h, label=c, color=col)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([t.replace('_',' ') for t in top.index], fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('GTEx median TPM'); ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('Tissue expression of the LONRF paralogs (16 tissues with highest LONRF3)',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
